system.description:
Your [Fatigue] is reduced by -10. At the same time, you may use up to a maximum of three [Food] items. The target of the items used at this time will be you only. If you use three items, your [Fate] will be +2. Yamato's southernmost region, the Retrable Islands, produce a secret egg wine. For a long time, the method of production was a mystery, but after the Catastrophe, the recipe was made public through exchanges with Adventurers.

Royal Egg of the Sahuagin [Core Material] (620G) + Healing Potion (Intermediate) (220G) ×3 + Panacea (Intermediate) (220G) ×3 + [Magic Catalyst 19] (340G) ×3 + Crafting Cost (850G)
